notes: New B.S. approved by the UCSB Academic Senate in January 2026; first cohort Fall 2026. Sources: Computer Science department curriculum page (ai.cs.ucsb.edu/curriculum) and the official ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE 2026-27 major requirements sheet (ai.cs.ucsb.edu). Per the department, students admitted to Computer Science for Fall 2026 could opt in after the SIR deadline; standard change-of-major pathways open in the 2028-29 academic year. The major sheet header lists 81 upper-division units while its listed items total 72 (36 required + 36 field electives); total degree 180 units per both sources. CMPSC 81 (4 units) appears in the sample 4-year plan but not in the requirements grid, so it is not encoded as a requirement.

requirements.note: 9 courses selected from the following list. Four units maximum from CMPSC 192 and 196 combined; only for students with GPA of 3.0 or higher.
